_comment: IBKR holdings, schema v2 (#27). shares/cost synced from live IBKR positions 2026-09-26 (get_account_positions, read-only). NB: homily_flex.sync only ever UPDATES known symbols — it never adds or deletes — so a newly opened position reaches this file only by a hand edit like the 2026-09-26 one that added META and removed the sold 9992/APP/ARM/DDOG/LRCX/MU/TSM (CYPH, 800 sh live, deliberately NOT added: it sits in daily_run.OBSERVE until the 2026-11-17 review and validate [71] forbids a fenced held name — owner decision pending). bucket: "A" = index sleeve (never sold/timed, excluded from stock-book %); "B" = earned core, set manually once the owner judges a name grew there via the add rules AND passes fundamentals (no automatic detection yet, see homily_positions.py); omitted = "C", the default satellite bucket the 10%-cap warning applies to. currency: omitted = USD; set explicitly for non-USD names (excluded from the USD stock-book denominator, R12). sector: the D-29 static label the #29 cluster line uses — owner-maintained, edit freely. Edit this file (not daily_run.py) when the book changes.
